title: 认识激光切割机（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/01_Laser Cutter 1 Intro.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/01_Laser Cutter 1 Intro（国内版）/src.py

points.S2: 激光看不见，标志要认得
points.S3: 切割时不离人，防火有准备

shots.scene: 欣欣站在创客空间里一台桌面式激光切割机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a bright makerspace beside a closed desktop laser cutter with a dark lid and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来认识激光切割机。

shots.scene: 木板、尺子、灭火器、培训证书四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a wooden board, a small wooden ruler, a fire extinguisher and a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 能做什么，怎么做，怎样才安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰在创客空间门口，看着架子上的激光木制作品两眼放光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the door of a makerspace, staring with excitement at shelves of laser-cut wooden crafts.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次来创客空间，看什么都新鲜。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手要掀开激光切割机的盖子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches out to lift the lid of a desktop laser cutter on a bench.
shots.narration: 他想马上动手，自己做个木牌。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，微笑着拦住他，指向墙上的空白培训告示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over, smiles and stops him, pointing at a blank training notice on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先上课，再上机。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从头开始，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧一叠空白课程卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small stack of blank course cards fanned out like playing cards.
shots.narration: 这一系列课，讲激光切割的基础。

shots.scene: 小研站在激光切割机旁，向几名学生介绍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside a desktop laser cutter and introduces it to a small group of students.
shots.narration: 也讲本场所这台设备该怎么用。

shots.scene: 一排编号空白课程卡依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A row of blank lesson cards with numbers one to seven lights up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 后面每一课，讲清一件事。

shots.scene: 桌面式激光切割机外观，盖子关闭
shots.prompt_en: A closed desktop laser cutter with a tinted viewing window sits on a sturdy bench. No people.
shots.narration: 这是一台二氧化碳激光切割机。

shots.scene: 机器内部示意：激光头射出一束光点在木板上
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a laser cutter: a laser head above a wooden board, a small bright dot where the beam meets the board. No people.
shots.narration: 它产生激光，聚成一个很小的光点。

shots.scene: 木板、亚克力板和其他板材三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a wooden board, a clear acrylic sheet and a stack of other sheets with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 能加工木板、亚克力等材料。

shots.scene: 切断、刻深、浅划三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: a board cut through by a line, a deeply engraved letter, and a light thin line on a board. No people.
shots.narration: 可以切割、雕刻，也可以划线。

shots.scene: 架子上摆着照片雕刻的木板和地图雕刻木板
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a wooden plaque engraved with a blank portrait picture and another engraved with a simple map outline. No people.
shots.narration: 可以把照片、地图雕在木板上。

shots.scene: 木拼图和带插槽的小木盒
shots.prompt_en: A wooden jigsaw puzzle and a small wooden box with finger joints on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 可以做拼图，也能拼出小木盒。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一把小木尺端详
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small wooden ruler and looks at it with interest.
shots.narration: 还能做一把属于自己的小尺子。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一枚小木尺徽章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small wooden ruler badge with a blank name area on top.
shots.narration: 大家的第一个作品，就是徽章尺。

shots.scene: 木尺徽章放大图，三处分别亮起
shots.prompt_en: A large illustration of a wooden ruler badge; its outline, its name area and its tick marks light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 它把三种加工方式都用上了。

shots.scene: 一大块木板，激光沿四边走一圈切下小木条
shots.prompt_en: A large wooden sheet; a dashed outline of a small rectangle is cut out along its four sides. No people.
shots.narration: 先从大木板上，沿四边切下来。

shots.scene: 木尺上方的名字区域被刻成较深的凹槽
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the top of the wooden ruler: a name area engraved as a deeper recessed block with blank letter shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 上面雕刻名字，刻得比较深。

shots.scene: 木尺下方一排细细的刻度线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the bottom of the wooden ruler: a row of fine, light tick marks. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度用划线，只是浅浅的一层灼痕。

shots.scene: 三块剖面示意：切透、深槽、浅痕
shots.prompt_en: Three cross-section diagrams of a board: one cut all the way through, one with a deep groove, one with a very shallow mark. No people.
shots.narration: 同一束激光，深浅不同，效果不同。

shots.scene: 小研指着笔记本屏幕上的空白设计图，三种线条颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a laptop showing a blank design with lines in three different colors.
shots.narration: 做哪种加工，在设计软件里设定。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：齿轮、木板、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a gear, a stack of boards and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 后面几课讲原理、材料和安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣点点头，翻开空白课程表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and opens a blank course schedule booklet.
shots.narration: 哪些材料能切、哪些不能，都会讲。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给阿杰等学生讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the young male student and other students in a training room with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 上机之前，先参加准入培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白考核卷上答题，旁边空白证书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank quiz sheet at a desk, with a blank certificate beside it.
shots.narration: 考核通过，获得授权才能使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰在设备旁的空白使用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank equipment logbook on a bench beside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 每次使用，按规定预约和登记。

shots.section_title: 激光看不见，标志要认得
shots.scene: 激光切割机机身上的激光警告标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a laser warning sign on the side of a desktop laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 机身上的这个标志，表示当心激光。
overlay: 激光看不见，标志要认得

shots.section_title: 激光看不见，标志要认得
shots.scene: 示意图：看不见的光束用虚线表示，眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a laser head with an invisible beam drawn as a dotted line, next to an eye icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 这种激光人眼看不见，却能灼伤。

shots.section_title: 激光看不见，标志要认得
shots.scene: 王老师指着设备的空白标签和空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank product label on the machine and a blank instruction manual.
shots.narration: 设备按国家标准分类，按说明书使用。

shots.section_title: 激光看不见，标志要认得
shots.scene: 盖子打开时激光仍在工作的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laser cutter with its lid open while the beam is on, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全联锁和盖子，不能随意拆改。

shots.section_title: 切割时不离人，防火有准备
shots.scene: 小研站在运行中的激光切割机前，透过观察窗看着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a running laser cutter and watches through the tinted window.
shots.narration: 切割时，人一刻也不能离开。
overlay: 切割时不离人，防火有准备

shots.section_title: 切割时不离人，防火有准备
shots.scene: 机器里木板冒出小火苗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small flame on a wooden board inside a laser cutter, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切木板，随时可能起火。

shots.section_title: 切割时不离人，防火有准备
shots.scene: 设备旁墙上的灭火器标志和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign on the wall above a fire extinguisher next to the laser cutter bench. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器放在旁边，要会用。

shots.section_title: 切割时不离人，防火有准备
shots.scene: 电话图标和红色火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red flame icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，撤离并拨打119。

shots.scene: 激光切割机后方的排烟管通向窗外，旁边是过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A desktop laser cutter with an exhaust duct running from its back to a fume filter unit and a window vent. No people.
shots.narration: 切割会产生烟尘，排烟要打开。

shots.scene: PVC板图标被红叉划掉，旁边毒气云图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plastic sheet with a chlorine molecule symbol and a toxic gas cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯材料如PVC，严禁切割。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一块板材，对照空白材料清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a sheet of material and compares it with a blank approved materials list.
shots.narration: 不认识的材料，先问清楚再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现激光切割机和三种加工图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a laser cutter and three small icons: a cut line, an engraving and a light line.
shots.narration: 激光切割机能切、能雕、能划线。

shots.scene: 培训证书和登记本打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank training certificate and a blank logbook, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先培训、获授权，再上机。

shots.scene: 不离人、灭火器、排烟三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a person watching a machine, a fire extinguisher and an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 守在机旁，备好灭火器，打开排烟。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着做好的木尺徽章向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up a finished wooden ruler badge and wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 下一课，我们讲激光切割安全，再见！
